children: Egypt has shortlisted seven consortia to bid for the management, operation and development of Hurghada International Airport under a public-private partnership (PPP) model, according to local Arabic language newspaper Al Borsa News.
A total of 10 consortia had submitted qualification applications for the project, the report said.

The qualified consortia will proceed to the next stage of the procurement process, which will include the issuance of Request for Proposal (RFP) documents and the timetable and procedures for bid submissions, the report added.
The names and members of the seven qualified consortia weren’t disclosed nor were the RFP issuance date, expected award date, concession duration and other details.

The International Finance Corporation (IFC) is providing transaction advisory services to the Egyptian government for the project as part of the Airports PSP Programme, which aims to involve private sector participation in the operation and expansion of selected Egyptian airports.
(Writing by Majda Muhsen; Editing by Anoop Menon)
